Best emergency battery packs for home backup (2026)

I searched for emergency home battery backups available in the US. The products you're looking for are typically called portable power stations or battery generators. They can power refrigerators, Wi-Fi routers, lights, phones, and other essentials during an outage without gasoline or exhaust fumes.

For most households, I'd start with a 2,000Wh (2kWh) battery. It's a practical balance between runtime, portability, and cost.

Actual runtime varies. Refrigerators cycle on and off and need extra starting power. Air conditioning, electric heaters, and ovens consume much more energy. Never connect a portable power station to household wiring without an approved transfer system installed by a qualified electrician.
